## Fit the EZ-DDM from summary statistics

All workshop models ship pre-fitted in `models/`, so this chunk loads the
cached fit if present and only re-fits when it is missing (re-fitting
requires cmdstanr — see `Install_Packages.R`, Part 2).

```{r}
#| label: fit-ez
#| eval: false
fit_file <- here("models", "ezddm_summary.rds")

if (file.exists(fit_file)) {
  fit_ez <- readRDS(fit_file)
} else {
```
